description: This file contains utility methods for the DumpViewer Android application, including string escaping, integer parsing, and displaying Toast messages on the main thread.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods for string escaping, integer parsing, and thread-safe Toast messaging.

methods.name: shellEscape
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe use in shell commands, adding quotes and escaping internal quotes if necessary.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Parses a string as a base-10 integer, returning a default value on failure.

methods.name: parseIntWithBase
methods.description: Parses a string as an integer of the specified base, returning a default value if parsing fails or input is null.

methods.name: toast
methods.description: Displays a Toast message on the main thread, using a Handler.
